PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 3, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT WRITTEN COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/92742129521

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54863  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54864  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, March 20, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54865  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency Annual Update.

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 3, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54866  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-020; and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-009), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval thereto, to allow for the expansion of onsite alcohol
  beverage sales at an existing restaurant with a California Department of Alcoholic
  Beverage Control (ABC) Type 47 License (On-Sale General - Eating Place)
  through the legalization of an outdoor patio bar (38 linear feet) at 310 South Pine
  Avenue in Subarea 6 of the Downtown Shoreline Planned Development District
  (PD-6). (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-54867  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-022;

  Approve a modification to a previously-approved Site Plan Review (App No. 1606-
  02) (MOD25-002) for a façade remodel at an existing 40,000-square-foot vacant
  retail space (former hardware store), approve a new Site Plan Review (SPR25-
  007), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to
  facilitate the conversion of a vacant 40,000 hardware store to a bowling alley and
  entertainment center, including the conversion of a 6,760-square-foot-garden
  center to building area at 4100 East Carson Street within the Long Beach
  Exchange (LBX) development in the Douglas Park North Planned Development
  District (PD-32 North);

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-001), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval thereto, for the operation of a bowling alley and
  entertainment center within the remodeled and expanded building in PD-32 North;
  and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-002) and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval thereto, for onsite alcohol beverage sales at a bowling
  alley and entertainment center with a California Department of Alcoholic Beverage
  Control (ABC) Type 47 License (On-Sale General – Eating Place). (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
